title: Reachability in a directed graph
statement: For a natural number $n$, a Boolean adjacency function $A$ on ordered pairs of vertices in $\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}$, and vertices $s$ and $t$, define $t$ to be reachable from $s$ when there is a finite directed walk from $s$ to $t$ whose every step $u\\to v$ satisfies $A(u,v)=\\mathrm{true}$. Walks of length zero are allowed.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean adjacency function on pairs of vertices in $\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}$
